root_filter.png.alt: Exponents zero through seventeen occupy three lanes according to their residue modulo three; lane height records an address, not a coefficient magnitude.

signed_cycle.png.alt: A four-node cycle has three positive edges and one negative closing edge; the accompanying target-row, source-column matrix has fourth power minus identity.

reciprocal_normalization.png.alt: Secant block coefficients 1, 1, 5, 61 and 1385 become ordinary coefficients after division by their matching even factorials.

parameter_polynomials.png.alt: On reciprocal orders zero through two, the first two block coefficients are r and r times (three r plus two), with marked values one and five at r equals one.

zero_orbits.png.alt: Three four-point zero orbits on the real and imaginary axes map under the fourth power to three positive reduced zeros on a logarithmic axis.

zero_moments.png.alt: Two order-two zero-moment partial sums over one through forty retained zeros approach exact dashed levels one half and one sixth from below.
